findings.quoted_finding: Setup nao medido separadamente e ESS/s rotulado com total parcial
defect_evidence: Input reads and package load precede the internal clock; setup/persistence are not phased.
ESS per total run second uses an internal time excluding startup, final writes and diagnostics.
mechanical_checks: Read exact reviewed source and verified review SHA-256.
findings.reasoning: This is a bounded instrumentation defect, not a model failure. Repair before empirical draws with unchanged scientific contract.
findings.disposition: Measure setup and persistence/error partial phases; explicitly name internal generation ESS/s and report external generation plus end-to-end compute separately. Independent delta review required.

findings.quoted_finding: Timeout nao garante encerramento de descendente que ignore SIGTERM
defect_evidence: SIGKILL was only issued when the leader failed to exit; independently reproduced descendant writes after sealing.
refuting_evidence: The actual rjags runner creates no explicit child process, limiting relevance to the current empirical path.
mechanical_checks: Reopened supervisor control flow and independent adversarial fixture result.
findings.reasoning: Nonblocking for present rjags path, but narrow lifecycle repair and regression test are safe within timeout supervision.
findings.disposition: Always terminate surviving own process group after timeout before sealing log; test descendant ignoring SIGTERM without any model execution.

reasons: Two scoped instrumentation repairs, one blocking, no change to models or empirical protocol. All earlier freezes preserved; independent delta review precedes pilot.
